title: Pothole / damaged road
steps: Photograph the pothole with a landmark in frame (geotag on).
File on the Sahaya app or call 1533 - note the ticket number.
If unresolved in the stated time, escalate to your ward Assistant Executive Engineer and tag the corporation on social media with the ticket number.
Dangerous at a junction? Also tell Traffic Police so they can barricade.
sla: Typically days to a couple of weeks; hot-mix repair depends on weather and tender cycles.

title: Garbage not collected / black spot
steps: Check your ward's collection timing - auto-tippers run on a fixed daily window.
Report on Sahaya with a photo of the pile and street name.
For bulk waste (construction debris, furniture) request a special pickup via your ward office.
Dumping repeatedly? Ask the ward Marshal to place cameras/fines - residents' associations do this successfully.
sla: Missed pickups are usually cleared within a day or two once ticketed.

title: Street light not working
steps: Note the pole number (painted/plated on the pole).
Report on Sahaya under street lights with pole number and photo.
If the whole row is dark (not individual bulbs) it may be a supply fault - call BESCOM 1912.
sla: Bulb replacement is generally quick; feeder faults take longer.

title: Power cut / voltage problem
steps: Check with neighbours and your own MCB first.
Call 1912 or use the BESCOM app/WhatsApp channel; give your RR number or the nearest landmark.
Fallen wire or sparking transformer: keep away, warn others and report it as an emergency.
Planned maintenance cuts are announced on the BESCOM site - check before complaining.
sla: Faults are usually restored within hours; transformer replacement can take longer.

title: Wrong electricity bill / meter issue
steps: Compare the meter photo/reading with the bill.
Raise a billing complaint on the BESCOM portal/app with your RR number.
Ask for a meter test if you suspect a faulty meter.
Unresolved? Escalate to the sub-division Assistant Executive Engineer, then the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum.
sla: Billing corrections are normally processed in the next cycle.

title: New electricity connection / load change
steps: Apply online on the BESCOM portal for the connection category.
Upload ownership/occupancy proof and ID.
Pay the estimate; schedule the site visit/meter installation.
sla: Depends on category; follow status on the portal.

title: No water / low pressure
steps: Check BWSSB's supply schedule for your area.
Call 1916 or use the BWSSB app with your RR/consumer number.
Dirty or smelly water: collect a sample photo and ask for a quality test.
Persistent shortage: apply to the sub-division office; RWAs can request tankers during shortages.
sla: Leaks are usually fixed in days; supply schedule issues take longer.

title: Sewage overflow / blocked drain
steps: Call 1916 and name the nearest landmark and sub-division.
Photograph the overflow - mention if it is entering homes or a lake.
Open roadside drains/nallahs are a corporation job: report on Sahaya instead.
sla: Priority complaint - usually attended within a day.

title: New water / sewer connection
steps: Apply on the BWSSB portal for water and sanitary connection.
Upload ownership proof, plan approval and occupancy/OC where required.
Pay the fee and schedule site inspection.
sla: Varies by area and pipeline availability.

title: Waterlogging / flooding / storm-water drain
steps: For immediate danger call 112; avoid flooded underpasses.
Report blocked storm-water drains/raja kaluves on Sahaya with photos.
If sewage is mixed with the water, also call BWSSB 1916.
sla: Emergency clearing is prioritised during monsoon.

title: Fallen tree / pruning / tree-felling
steps: Fallen tree blocking road: Sahaya + 112 if there is danger.
Pruning or felling on private land needs permission from the Tree Officer/Forest cell - apply before cutting.
Report illegal felling with photos and the exact location.
sla: Emergency clearance in hours; permissions take weeks.

title: Stray dogs / animal nuisance
steps: Report on Sahaya for sterilisation/vaccination drives (ABC programme).
For a dog bite: wash with soap and water for 15 minutes and see a doctor immediately for anti-rabies treatment.
Feeding disputes: speak to your RWA and ward office - dogs cannot be lawfully removed from their territory.
sla: Drives are scheduled by ward.

title: Property tax / khata / e-khata
steps: Property tax is paid online through the corporation portal using your PID/application number.
e-Khata: apply online; keep sale deed, tax receipts and EC ready.
B-khata properties have limits on loans/approvals - check regularisation options with your ward office.
sla: Varies; track via application number.

title: Birth / death certificate
steps: Hospital-registered births are issued through the ward health office / online portal.
Delayed registration needs an affidavit and an order - start at the ward Health Officer.
Use the e-Janma / state portal where available for downloads.
sla: Within the statutory period if registered on time.

title: Trade licence / shop licence
steps: Apply for a trade licence through the corporation portal with premises documents.
Food businesses also need an FSSAI registration/licence.
Hoardings and signboards need separate advertisement permission.
sla: Varies by category.

title: Driving licence / learner's licence
steps: Apply on Parivahan (Sarathi) and book the slot.
Learner's: online test; permanent DL after the mandated gap with a driving test at your RTO.
Renewals and address changes are online too.
sla: Appointment-based.

title: Vehicle registration / transfer / fitness
steps: Use Parivahan Vahan services for ownership transfer, NOC, HSRP and fitness.
Both parties' details are needed for transfer; check for pending challans first.
HSRP plates must be booked through the official portal only.
sla: Slot-dependent.

title: E-challan / traffic fine dispute
steps: Check pending challans by vehicle number on the official portals.
Pay online; if the challan is wrong, contest it with evidence via the BTP grievance route.
Never pay via links sent by SMS from unknown numbers - fake challan scams are common.
sla: Disputes take weeks.

title: Illegal parking / towing
steps: Photograph the vehicle with number plate and location.
Report to Traffic Police through their grievance channels or 112 if it is blocking an emergency route.
Towed vehicle? Locate it through the BTP towing details and pay the fine at the nearest station.
sla: Immediate if patrol nearby.

title: Noise / loudspeakers / late-night pubs
steps: Call 112 for noise beyond permitted hours; note the address and time.
Persistent commercial/industrial noise: also write to KSPCB with recordings.
Join your RWA - collective complaints get action faster.
sla: 112 responds in minutes when units are nearby.

title: Lake pollution / encroachment / froth
steps: Report encroachment or dumping to the corporation lake wing with photos.
Industrial or sewage inflow: report to KSPCB and BWSSB.
Lake groups and citizen volunteers often know the history - ask them for context before escalating.
sla: Slow - cases may involve multiple agencies and the courts.

title: Bus / metro complaint
steps: Note bus number, time and stop.
Use the BMTC / BMRCL official apps or websites for feedback and lost-property.
Safety issues - call 112.
sla: Varies.

title: Illegal construction / building plan
steps: Check the sanctioned plan at the corporation's building section.
Report violations with photos and the plot address to the zonal engineer.
For BDA layouts and sites, check with BDA's planning wing as well.
sla: Enforcement can take months; courts may be involved.

title: Property registration / EC
steps: Book on the Kaveri portal; check guidance value and stamp duty.
Get an Encumbrance Certificate for the last 30 years before buying.
After registration apply for khata transfer at the corporation.
sla: Slot-dependent.

title: Auto / taxi overcharging
steps: Note the auto number, time and place; take a photo of the plate.
File with the Transport Department/RTO or Traffic Police grievance channels with those details.
Ride-hailing refusal/overcharge: also report in-app and keep the screenshot.
sla: Varies.

title: Cyber fraud / online scam
steps: Call 1930 immediately - the first hour matters most.
Report at cybercrime.gov.in and keep all screenshots, transaction IDs and numbers.
Tell your bank to block cards/UPI at once.
sla: Time-critical.

title: Safety emergency (women, child, medical, fire)
steps: Call 112 (all emergencies). Fire: 101. Ambulance: 108. Women: 181. Child: 1098.
Share live location with someone you trust.
After the emergency, ask for the FIR/complaint number.
sla: Immediate.
